shortDescription: Manages Eth-Trunk interfaces on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: force
options.description: When true it forces Eth-Trunk members to match what is declared in the members param. This can be used to remove members.

options.name: hash_type
options.description: Hash algorithm used for load balancing among Eth-Trunk member interfaces.

options.name: members
options.description: List of interfaces that will be managed in a given Eth-Trunk. The interface name must be full name.

options.name: min_links
options.description: Specifies the minimum number of Eth-Trunk member links in the Up state. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to the maximum number of interfaces that can be added to a Eth-Trunk interface.

options.name: mode
options.description: Specifies the working mode of an Eth-Trunk interface.

options.name: state
options.description: Manage the state of the resource.

options.name: trunk_id
options.description: Eth-Trunk interface number. The value is an integer. The value range depends on the assign forward eth-trunk mode command. When 256 is specified, the value ranges from 0 to 255. When 512 is specified, the value ranges from 0 to 511. When 1024 is specified, the value ranges from 0 to 1023.
